We’ve got our hands on every model of BMW M, and they’re about to go head-to-head over the quarter mile! The question is, which one will come out on top? Let’s take a closer look at the competitors… 

- BMW X5M: 
4.4-litre twin-turbo V8, 625hp & 750Nm, AWD, 2,400kg

- BMW X3M
3-litre twin-turbo inline-six, 510hp & 650Nm, AWD, 2,010kg

- BMW M2
3-litre twin-turbo inline-six, 480hp & 650Nm, RWD, 1,730kg

- BMW M4 Comp Convertible
3-litre twin-turbo inline-six, 530hp & 650Nm, AWD, 1,925kg

- BMW XM Label
4.4-litre twin-turbo V8 hybrid, 748hp & 1,000Nm, AWD, 2,720kg

- BMW M3 Comp Touring
3-litre twin-turbo inline-six, 530hp & 650Nm, AWD, 1,865kg

- BMW M5 Touring
4.4-litre twin-turbo V8 hybrid, 727hp & 1,000Nm, AWD, 2,480kg

- BMW M8 Competition
4.4-litre twin-turbo V8, 625hp & 750nm, AWD, 1,995kg
